title: Screen Reader Manual-Pass Record
description: JSON Schema for one screen-reader manual-pass record emitted to pulse-app/ui/test-results/a11y-sr/<sr>-<surface>-<ISO-date>.jsonl. Aligned to obs-plan.md §3 Log format JSON schema + §6 Required fields binding contract; extends a11y-plan.md §3 Structured Violation JSON Schema with SR-specific fields. Documentation-only — no runtime validator installed at chunk #14.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the assertion record.

level.description: Per obs-plan §6 Log levels mapping: info on pass, warn on partial, error on fail.

target.description: {module}.{operation} convention per obs-plan §2 Naming. Surface suffix is snake_case enumerated; no high-cardinality at this level.

message.description: Single-line summary of the assertion (e.g., 'P2 dialog title announcement verified'). Multi-line forbidden per obs-plan §11 Logs anti-pattern.

surface.description: Per layout-templates.md §Surface vocabulary; verbatim, no abbreviation, no pluralization changes.

surface_kind.description: webview = React/Tauri webview ARIA tree; os-native = OS accessibility API (NSStatusItem / NotifyIcon / AppIndicator).

screen_reader.description: Per a11y-plan §3 Screen Reader Test Pattern fixed pairings.

navigation_mode.description: Per a11y-plan §7 Per-surface SR test pattern table: NVDA browse mode arrow keys / VoiceOver VO+arrow rotor / Orca arrow keys caret mode.

critical_path.description: Per a11y-plan §3 Critical paths table P1-P7.

status.description: pass = announcement matches expected; fail = mismatch; blocked = surface not yet implemented (chunks #25/#28/#33/#36/#37/#38); partial = announcement present but not exact match.

tool.description: Per a11y-plan §3 Structured Violation JSON Schema; manual SR pass is tool='manual' (axe-core / pa11y / Lighthouse use their respective tool names).

sr_announcement_expected.description: Single-line expected SR announcement string. Multi-line announcements MUST use '\n' escapes per obs-plan §11 Logs anti-pattern.

sr_announcement_actual.description: Single-line observed SR announcement string. Multi-line MUST use '\n' escapes.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector or DOM identifier for the asserted element.

metadata.description: Optional nested metadata; high-cardinality fields (per-tester-name, per-run-UUID, reduced-motion variant flag) live here, NEVER at the top-level target.

run_id.description: Optional per-run UUID for cross-record correlation within a single pass session.

reduced_motion.description: true when the run was performed under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce per design-system §Motion + a11y-plan §SC 2.3.3.
